title: Edit Form Settings » Submission Settings | Brilliant Directories Documentation | BD Support
content: Edit Form Settings » Submission Settings Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000078794 In this article, we will be going over the Submission Settings that can be found under Edit Form Settings: What Happens After Form Submitted Setting & Additional Options This setting will allow the website owner to select an action to perform after the form is submitted. If the Display Success Pop-Up Message option is selected, the system will display an option to edit the Success Message Text on the fly: The wording added here will display after the form is submitted: If the Display Success Alert Message option is selected, the system will display an option to edit the Success Message Text on the fly: The wording added here will display after the form is submitted: If the Redirect to Another Page option is selected, the system will display an option to edit the destination URL and the Success Message Text: When the selected form is submitted, the system will redirect the user to the specified URL: Save Member Information option should only be selected for member account forms like Contact Details, Listing Details, post type forms and About Me: If this option is not selected for the forms specified, member information will not be saved in the database. For additional assistance: Email support@brilliantdirectories.com or create a ticket Inside Your Account Dashboard . Was this article helpful and accurate?
